headline: Brazil September Formal Job Creation Falls to 121,305
summary: Brazil created 121,305 formal jobs in September, missing market expectations and marking a 43.5% decline compared to the same period last year.
why: The Caged report is a key indicator of Brazilian labor market health, which influences the central bank's monetary policy decisions regarding the Selic interest rate.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Lower-than-expected job growth suggests a cooling labor market, potentially influencing central bank interest rate policy.
